brief: THE BET — the plaza's midday. Three wide shots on seed 42 (early summer, 10:30/13:25/16:55) show the plaza holding 0–1 people; it is the longest-untouched domain (14 iterations). Step one, before building: count plaza presence (x 98..112, y 18..46) by hour on HEAD over 10 seeds × 3 summer days and write the histogram into the ledger — that is c127. Step two: give the plaza a midday of its own. Families: the courtyard already has a KID figure (spawnAgent(): a.kind 'kid', a.small, speed 2.6+, drawn by drawPerson(), named 'a child, running about') that never leaves the courtyard. Build spawnFamilyAgent() — its OWN source under its own cap (FAM_CAP 2, a window ~10:00–17:00 on dry days with daylight > 0.35, rate floored so a summer day sees 3–5 families; never a share of eastCap/laneCap), entering by EAST_GATE_A (and a share by the quay, EAST_GATE_Q). The parent takes a PLAZA_BENCHES seat or the fountain stand (spawnEastAgent's plaza branch has both); the child is a FOLLOWER of the parent by the follower law (re-target off the LEADER several times a second, catch-up scaled to the gap) but with a lead of its own: loops on the roundel, and runs AT the plaza's birds. The plaza has no birds unbidden — updateWildlife lands birds[] on the courtyard lawn and the lane only — so give the plaza a landing band of pigeons on the paving (the 'scare' rule at 4.5 cells already puts a hopping bird up when anyone comes near; the child triggers it, the flush is the payoff). The child returns to the parent's side between runs and the pair leave together, retracing. personName: 'a child, chasing the pigeons' / 'someone on a bench, watching a child'. A 150–300-line diff is expected and welcome: source, follower with a lead, pigeon band, two names, one announce line, __entities role. No R() in draw; every new spawn draw on the family's own roll.
successLooksLike: probes/plaza-midday.mjs, 10 seeds × 3 summer days: plaza presence at 12:00 rises from HEAD's median 0 to 2–4; at least one child-triggered bird flush per family visit; the child never further than 6 cells from the parent for more than 3 s; families 3–5 per summer day, 0 in rain and after dark; census PASS (reshuffle only); the pair leave together. shots/b90-plaza-noon.png shows a small figure mid-run and birds in the air on the roundel; the wide shot at 13:25 on seed 42 is no longer an empty plaza.
avoid: Do not widen eastCap or the spawnEastAgent plaza share (0.32) — the WATCH note says that budget is already shared seven ways; a family is its own source. Do not route families through the courtyard's spawnAgent(). Do not let the child's runs cross the fountain basin (crumbSpot's keep box) or the roundel's tree pits. The kid speed (2.6–3.6) with a follower re-target can trip the motion gate's median rule — compare the worst step against HEAD's kids on the lawn before calling it a bug.
